assets.title:

나에게만
친절하다!
assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Image 1 is the ORIGINAL poster and edit target. Extract and faithfully recreate ONLY the large Korean title lettering in the lower third of this poster, with its original letterforms, pink/white/periwinkle brush-stroke color transitions, small hearts, fine underline swooshes and sparkles. The original text must be preserved exactly; do NOT shorten or rename it. Exact three-line title:
쌀쌀맞은 갸루짝꿍이
나에게만
친절하다!
The word 갸루짝꿍이 has exactly FIVE syllables: 갸 / 루 / 짝 / 꿍 / 이. Write all five accurately. Do not substitute 갸루가, 가루주가, 갸루주가, 갸루짝궁이 or 방과 후. Match the reference's lively sharp dry-brush romance calligraphy very closely: smaller white 쌀쌀맞은, large hot-pink 갸루짝꿍 with a small white 이 along the upper line, white 나에게만 in the middle, large white-to-pink/periwinkle 친절하다! below. A compact three-line landscape wordmark on a 1536x1024 transparent canvas, not a full poster. Keep lettering and restrained ornaments fully inside generous safe transparent margins. Remove ALL characters, desks, books, classroom, background, small character names and irrelevant text. Actual alpha transparency between, around and within the lettering, no opaque dark rectangle, no fake checkerboard. No scene or person. No extra word, watermark or logo. Preserve the original handcrafted typography rather than replacing it with a UI font.
